steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Tell me more!

steps.name: Rosella
steps.text: Oh, be careful with the candle! Don't get burnt!

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Ah! Can't mess up the shape... It won't look pretty.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: I need to... make it look nicer... for Mamma.

steps.name: Rosella
steps.text: Alright, I've told you a lot already. It's all boring adventures and the same old day-to-day life. As for Kazdel in the legends...

steps.name: Rosella
steps.text: It's kind of embarrassing to say, but none of us have ever been.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Kazdel is to the Sarkaz... like what Laterano is to the Sankta, right? It's the Sarkaz homeland...

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Everyone's gotta be very happy. There are cotton candy food trucks, right? And candy stores, too... There are lots of happy Sarkaz on the streets, all of them saying hi to each other!

steps.name: Rosella
steps.text: Maybe...

steps.name: Rosella
steps.text: It could be like that, one day.

steps.name: Rosella
steps.text: Why don't we talk about you instead, Cecelia? What are your papa and mama like?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: I... I don't actually know...

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: I haven't seen Papà that many times... Every time we went to see him, Mamma did a lot of work to prepare, and we always left at night... We walked very far... to the forest.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: We met him in the forest, and he wore a big cape, like he hurried to us from somewhere far away...

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: I don't actually remember what he looks like very well, but I remember his horns! They're black and straight, and they twinkle bright under the moonlight!

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: He took me by my hand and walked around the forest. He told me the names of the trees and how old they were... It gets very quiet at night outside the city. You don't even hear fowlbeasts. But I was never scared.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: He grabbed my hand so tight. It kinda hurt... but I didn't say anything.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Every time we saw each other, he looked like he was even happier than I was! And he also looked... a little nervous?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: When I got tired, Mamma would carry me on her back and take me home. When I looked back, Papà would be there under the big tree. He kept looking at us. Even after we got very far away, he would still stand there...

steps.name: Rosella
steps.text: Your mama and papa are both wonderful people.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Mamma's amazing! She knows how to do everything!

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Look. This is Mamma's guardian gun! Ezell gave it to me.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Mamma said that Papà couldn't beat her in a fight if he tried... She always let Papà win! But I know Papà's really amazing, too!

steps.name: Rosella
steps.text: Haha, Cecelia. When I say 'wonderful,' it probably doesn't mean the same thing as what you mean by 'amazing.'

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Really? I'm sure Papà and Mamma are both wonderful and amazing!

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Mamma never told me how she met Papà, though. Every time I asked her, she would start talking about something else... Why didn't she want to tell me?

steps.name: Rosella
steps.text: When you're still a kid, there are a lot of other, more important things. Do you like watching tea brew? When I was your age, I loved looking at brewing tea. The water would get darker and darker by the second...

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Rosella... The way you're talking about something else now is just like Mamma...

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: I may look like I don't know a lot, but actually... I know a little.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: I ran all around the city yesterday, but I didn't see any Sarkaz besides you... Sarkaz aren't supposed to come to Laterano, are they?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: That's why Papà and Mamma shouldn't be together... No, I mean, there is somebody who doesn't want him to be with Mamma, right?

steps.name: Rosella
steps.text: No, there's no such thing as two people who shouldn't be together... All this will change. And it won't be too long from now... It will happen.

steps.name: Rosella
steps.text: Love isn't a crime.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: I understand...

steps.name: Rosella
steps.text: That's why we are here.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: And when that day comes, can I walk around Laterano all I want?

steps.name: Rosella
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: I won't have to hide in my room anymore? I can visit all the candy stores in Laterano one at a time?

steps.name: Rosella
steps.text: Just once? You can go as many times as you want.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Wow... I want that day to come soon... I wanna grow up soon!

steps.name: Rosella
steps.text: Right, maybe if you grow up soon, it'll just...

steps.name: Rosella
steps.text: No, Cecelia, there's no hurry. When I was your age, I also thought that growing up would solve everything, but when I finally grew up...

steps.name: Rosella
steps.text: Growing up is very, very, very tough, Cecelia, and it will be even harder for you. The burden that you'll carry on your shoulders... No, never mind. You're still a kid. Let's not think about that.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Even though everyone grows up?

steps.name: Rosella
steps.text: Right... We don't have a choice but to grow up.
Rosella, who has been smiling the whole time, suddenly seems somewhat lonely, all of a sudden.
She looks out the chapel's window at the graveyard outside. It's full of blooming flowers, and in the distance, the tall statue in the center of Lateran City makes a faint impression.
She starts humming a song, sorrowful but with a hint of hope.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Oh, that song! You hummed it yesterday too...

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: When Mamma taught me that song, she said she didn't know the words anymore, so she always just sang it with lalalas, but I really like how it sounds... What is the song actually about?

steps.name: Rosella
steps.text: This is a Sarkaz song. It's about a hero who's about to go on a journey to do something really amazing, and that's why everyone sang this song to say their goodbyes and send him on his way, hoping he'll come back safely.

steps.name: Rosella
steps.text: The hero of the song is going somewhere far away to fulfill his dreams...

steps.name: Rosella
steps.text: It may be a long, long journey, but he will surely, certainly...

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Mister Ezell! Mister Friar!

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: What are you chatting about?

steps.name: Rosella
steps.text: Good day, Guide—Nothing important. Just old stories about the Sarkaz and a few trivial topics.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: I'm having fun... I've never talked to someone so long.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Mister Ezell, did you pick these flowers?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Yes, I thought... we could extract the flower's fragrance and give the candles a little scent.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Fragrance can help guide the departed in the right direction.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: That's so nice! Thanks, Mister Ezell!

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Um... Actually... I'm... I'm a little scared.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: When I say goodbye to Mamma at the funeral... That's going to be the last goodbye, right?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Does that really mean I can't see her anymore? Not even on holidays? Not even once in a long while, like Papà? Even... if I just want her to pat my head?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Even... Even if...

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: There's still a story about an angel and a burdenbeast... that she hasn't finished telling me?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Cecelia...

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Tonight's the last time, Cecelia.

steps.name: Rosella
steps.text: I'll stay with you in your mama's room tonight, okay? All of us will be there. You won't be alone.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: A Sarkaz watching over a Sankta child and her mother...

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: The candlelight may be feeble, but it too can light up the path to the other side.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Lemuen, we're here to see you.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: We brought you some dessert.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: A fruit tart I swiped from the Basilica.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Welcome. By the way, that cactus looks disgusting.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: That's our girl, Lemuen. You've got fine eyes.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Do you two really miss me so much that you have to visit every day?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: We could come see you every hour, if that's what you want.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Trying to curry favor, are you, Mostima? And you, Fiammetta... That's a terrible smile if I've ever seen one.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Did something happen?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: It's Andoain...

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: You ran into him.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: We encountered a Sarkaz who had infiltrated Laterano, and when I was chasing her... I saw his Originium Arts firsthand.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I see. It's good that you aren't hurt.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Lemuen, are you sure you're okay here? This is a normal hospital. If he...

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: He's paid me a visit already.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: What did you just—

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: *Sigh*...
A silence descends upon the room.
Lemuen looks at the flowers on the table.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: The way you two talk about him is like... you're talking about a picnic you had over the weekend.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Lemuen, I'm not mad about you...

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: But, whenever we talk about him, you... and Mostima too. Each and every time, whenever I bring it up, you two always have that same look.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Whenever I see that expression on your faces, it makes me think... maybe it wasn't him who went crazy that day. That I lost my mind.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: We felt it, is all...

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Your Sankta hive mind again? Fine, you felt what he felt. Why did you point your gun at him, then?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: That has nothing to do with this. It didn't matter how... out of it he was, I couldn't let him take the Lock and Key.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: What about after that? You fell because of him! Does that not bother you?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Lemuen, it was his Arts that put you in this hospital. You fell into a coma for five whole years... does that not bother you?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Fiammetta...

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Trust me, I'm on your side.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: It's just that I could really feel...

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: I don't want to hear that word anymore.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Do you think I'm mad about all this for no good reason?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Of course not, I understand...

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Right, of course. All of you understand.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: I'm the only one who doesn't.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Hey, Fiammetta!

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Fiammetta, Fiammetta!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Shimmering Vigil!

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: You want me to bash your face in?!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Listen to me!

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: I've got something to say to you, Mostima!

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: I'm done with you stinking Sankta already! Your empathy? The way you understand each other? I don't want to hear any of it!

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Did those halos fry your angel brains? You and Lemuen almost died in those ruins!

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Why aren't you angry? Why aren't you mad? Why am I the only one... the only one who's mad?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Don't give me that arrogant smile and that 'nothing matters' attitude! You had to leave Laterano and drift all across the world, bum out in the boonies. Whose fault do you think that was?!

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: I followed you all the way to Victoria, to Leithanien, Sargon, Yan...

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: What do you think that was for?!

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: You, Lemuen, Andoain... our team. There was a time... when we trusted each other.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: What kind of God Almighty reason does he have anyway? What gave him the right to betray our trust? And what gave you two the right to understand him? Why should I have to understand him?!

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Do you know how much I miss those days? All those times we finished a mission after all those close calls... all those times Lemuen took us out to drinks... all those times we tried out a new dessert shop...

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Even those times he fixed our reports...

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: What gave him the right to ruin it all?!

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Those days...

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Those days... mean a lot to me...

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I understand...

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Fi...

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Lateran irises.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: They grow only in the Central Garden of Saint Marcel, the Sunset Chapel, and the Ecclesia Requietum in Stevonus.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Come on, we'll go together.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You're my warden. Better make sure I'm not hurt on the job.
